objective_pt: Falar de como você usa apps e aparelhos, explicar um problema técnico simples ("It keeps crashing") e dar opinião sobre o uso do celular com "used to" e comparações.

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando dos apps e aparelhos que a pessoa usa.
prompts: Which apps do you use the most?
Could you live without your phone for a week?
watchFor: Dizer "I use much the phone"; o natural é "I use my phone a lot".

exercises.prompt: How much time do you spend on your phone every day?
accepted: How much time do you spend on your phone every day
How much time do you spend on your phone each day

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você passa umas quatro horas por dia no celular.
exercises.listen: How much time do you spend on your phone?
accepted: About four hours a day
I spend about four hours a day on my phone
Around four hours a day
Probably four hours a day
I spend around four hours a day on it
About four hours a day, I think
Maybe four hours a day

commonErrors.correction_en: I spend about four hours a day on my phone.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "on my phone" e "a day" (ou "per day"): "four hours a day on my phone".
commonErrors.correction_en: I spend about four hours a day on my phone.

options: I use very much my laptop.
I use my laptop a lot.
I use a lot my laptop.
exercises.explanation_pt: Em inglês o objeto fica colado ao verbo e o "a lot" vai no fim: "I use my laptop a lot".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender verbos e expressões de tecnologia do dia a dia.
prompts: What do you do when your computer freezes?
How often do you update your apps?
watchFor: Usar "I downloaded the photo to Instagram"; postar é "upload" ou "post".
Dizer "the internet fell"; o natural é "the internet is down" ou "went down".

exercises.example_en: This app keeps crashing every time I open it.
I forgot to charge my phone last night.

accepted: The internet is down
The internet's down
The internet went down
The internet has gone down
The Wi-Fi is down
The internet stopped working
The internet isn't working

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cair" a internet não é "fall". Use "is down" ou "went down".

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar palavras de tecnologia que brasileiros adaptam demais: "Wi-Fi", "laptop", "download", "used to".
prompts: Say "used to". Is it "iused tu" or "yoosta"?
watchFor: Pronunciar "used to" separado ("iuzed tu"); na fala vira "YOOS-tuh".
Colocar vogal no fim de "laptop" e "chat" ("laptopi", "chati").

exercises.prompt: I used to read paper books, but now I read on my tablet.
accepted: I used to read paper books, but now I read on my tablet

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita sem vogal extra no fim de "laptop" e "chat".
exercises.prompt: I use my laptop to chat with my team.
accepted: I use my laptop to chat with my team

exercises.instruction_pt: Como "used to" soa na fala natural?
exercises.explanation_pt: Em "used to" (costumava), o "d" some e o "s" é surdo: "YOOS-tuh".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender um problema técnico e dar uma solução simples.
prompts: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
What's the most annoying tech problem you've had?
watchFor: Usar "Did you try to restart?" está ok, mas "Have you tried restarting it?" é mais natural.
Esquecer o objeto: "turn off and on" sem "it".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha qual é o problema.
exercises.listen: I can't log in to my account. It keeps saying my password is wrong, but I'm sure it's right.
options: Não consegue entrar na conta por causa da senha.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I can't log in" = não consigo entrar; "it keeps saying my password is wrong" = fica dizendo que a senha está errada.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e sugira que a pessoa desligue e ligue de novo.
exercises.listen: My laptop is really slow today. I don't know what to do.
accepted: Have you tried turning it off and on again
Have you tried restarting it
Try turning it off and on again
Try restarting it
Why don't you restart it
You should restart it
Did you try restarting it
Turn it off and on again

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Desligar e ligar um aparelho é "turn off / turn on" ou "restart".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com pronome, ele fica no meio do phrasal verb: "turn it off", e não "turn off it".
commonErrors.correction_en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que antigamente você jogava videogame, mas não joga mais.
accepted: I used to, but I don't anymore
I used to, but not anymore
I used to play, but I don't anymore
I used to play video games, but I don't anymore
Not anymore, but I used to
I used to, but I stopped
I used to play a lot, but not anymore

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para um hábito do passado, use "used to" (no passado): "I used to play".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to, but I don't anymore.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Não mais" é "not anymore" ou "I don't anymore". "No more" soa como uma ordem ("chega!").
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to, but I don't anymore.

teacher.goal_pt: Discutir o papel da tecnologia: o que melhorou, o que piorou e como era antes.
prompts: How was life different before smartphones?
Do you think kids spend too much time on screens?
What technology couldn't you live without?
watchFor: Usar "before" com presente: "Before, I read more" ok, mas incentive "I used to read more".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu costumava ligar para os meus amigos, mas agora eu mando mensagem."
accepted: I used to call my friends, but now I text them
I used to call my friends, but now I send them messages
I used to phone my friends, but now I text them
I used to call my friends, but now I just text them
I used to call my friends, but now I message them

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Costumava" para hábitos do passado é "used to". "Costume" é fantasia.
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to call my friends, but now I text them.
I used to call my friends, but now I text them.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Hoje em dia é mais fácil trabalhar de casa."
accepted: Nowadays it's easier to work from home
Nowadays it is easier to work from home
These days it's easier to work from home
Today it's easier to work from home
It's easier to work from home nowadays
Working from home is easier nowadays

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivo curto faz comparativo com "-er": "easier", e não "more easy".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays it's easier to work from home.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Hoje em dia" é "nowadays" ou "these days", e trabalhar de casa é "work from home".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nowadays it's easier to work from home.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: My phone keeps running out of battery.

exercises.instruction_pt: Dê a sua opinião sobre tecnologia na sua vida.
exercises.prompt_en: How has technology changed your daily life? Is it mostly good or bad?
guidelines_pt: Compare o antes e o agora: "I used to..., but now I...".
Dê um exemplo bom e um ruim, com comparativos ("easier", "more stressful").
Conclua com a sua opinião: "Overall, I think...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "used to", "keep + -ing" e os phrasal verbs "turn on/off".
prompts: What did you use to do before you had a smartphone?
What keeps happening with your phone?
watchFor: "I use to" no lugar de "I used to".

exercises.prompt: My battery is about to die. Do you have a charger?
accepted: My battery is about to die. Do you have a charger
My battery's about to die. Do you have a charger
My battery is about to die. Have you got a charger
I forgot my password
I've forgotten my password
I have forgotten my password
I forgot my password again
I can't remember my password

exercises.explanation_pt: Com pronome, ele fica no meio do phrasal verb: "turn it off".

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "use".
exercises.sentence: When I was a kid, I ___ to play outside every day.
accepted: used

commonErrors.correction_en: When I was a kid, I used to play outside every day.
